theorems.name: Submission.f036cc6b1f_pic_psp_sign_transversal
theorems.statement: ∀ (Δ : Subgroup (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ)), (-1 : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ∈ Δ → ∃ L : Set Δ, (∀ δ : Δ, ∃ γ : Δ, γ ∈ L ∧ ((γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) = (δ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ∨ (γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) = -(δ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ))) ∧ (∀ γ : Δ, γ ∈ L → ∀ η : Δ, η ∈ L → ((γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) = (η : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ∨ (γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) = -(η : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ)) → γ = η)
